designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Florida Panther National Wildlife Refuge to protect habitat for the endangered Florida panther.

authority.citation: Endangered Species Act of 1973; Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Florida Panther National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, 508 Florida Panther National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 168117): "The Florida Panther National Wildlife Refuge was established in June 1989"; purposes under the Endangered Species Act and Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956
